title: Honeymoon & Romantic Escape Package
metaTitle: Honeymoon Package in Lansdowne | Flutter Hotels & Resorts
metaDescription: Celebrate your honeymoon with a valley-view stay, private balcony, candle light dinner and bed decoration at Flutter Hotels & Resorts, Lansdowne.
shortDesc: A valley view room, private balcony, romantic candlelight dinner under Himalayan stars, and bed decoration for newlyweds.
inclusions: 2 Nights stay in Super Deluxe Valley View Room
Complimentary Breakfast & Romantic Candlelight Dinner
Special room bed decoration with fresh flowers
Welcome cake & non-alcoholic fruit champagne
15% discount on additional dining & room service

itinerary.title: Check-in & Candlelight Dinner
itinerary.desc: Check-in at 12:00 PM with welcome drinks. Relax on your private balcony overlooking the Garhwal valley. Enjoy a romantic candlelight dinner in the evening.

itinerary.title: Local Sightseeing & Bonfire Evening
itinerary.desc: Morning breakfast followed by local sightseeing (Tip In Top, Bhulla Lake). Evening bonfire with music on our lush lawns.

itinerary.title: Breakfast & Checkout
itinerary.desc: Morning breakfast, memorable photos on the lawn, and check-out by 10:00 AM.

faqs.q: Can we customize the dinner menu?
faqs.a: Yes, our chef will customize the candlelight dinner menu according to your dietary preferences.
Late check-out up to 1:00 PM is subject to room availability.

title: 2N/3D Group Departure Package (Delhi Pickup Included)
metaTitle: 2N/3D Delhi Group Departure to Lansdowne | Flutter Hotels
metaDescription: Join our 2N/3D group departure to Lansdowne — ₹4,999/person, Delhi pickup from Akshardham Metro, full itinerary with bonfire & DJ night.
shortDesc: No driving or trip planning — AC Volvo/Tempo transport from Delhi Akshardham Metro, resort stay, bonfire & DJ evening included.
inclusions: AC Transport from Akshardham Metro Station, Delhi to Lansdowne & return
2 Nights stay in Deluxe rooms on twin/triple sharing
All meals (2 Breakfasts, 2 Dinners)
Bonfire & DJ Night on resort lawns
Sightseeing tour to Bhulla Lake, St. John Church & Tip-In-Top

itinerary.title: Delhi Pickup & Resort Check-in
itinerary.desc: Board AC vehicle at 6:00 AM from Akshardham Metro, Delhi. Scenic drive to Lansdowne. Check-in at Flutter Hotels & Resorts. Evening tea & snacks.

itinerary.title: Lansdowne Sightseeing & DJ Night
itinerary.desc: Visit local viewpoints & army museum. Evening bonfire with DJ music and lavish dinner buffer.

itinerary.title: Return Journey to Delhi
itinerary.desc: Morning breakfast, checkout and return journey to Delhi by evening.

faqs.q: Where is the pickup point in Delhi?
faqs.a: Akshardham Metro Station Gate No. 2 at 6:00 AM.
Resort meals (Breakfast & Dinner) are included. En-route tea/meals can be purchased directly.

title: Weekend Garhwal Hills Getaway Package
metaTitle: Weekend Getaway Package | Flutter Hotels & Resorts
metaDescription: Unwind in Lansdowne with our weekend getaway package — 2 nights stay, daily breakfast, bonfire & 20% off room service.
shortDesc: Unwind in the fresh pine air of Lansdowne — 2 nights room stay, daily breakfast, evening tea with Garhwali snacks, and bonfire.
inclusions: 2 Nights stay in Valley View or Garden View Room
Daily Chef Special Breakfast for 2
Evening High Tea with local Garhwali snacks
Access to indoor games & outdoor lawns
Free high-speed Wi-Fi and ample car parking

itinerary.title: Friday Arrival
itinerary.desc: Check-in, relax in your room, and enjoy mountain breeze. Evening tea & warm bonfire on lawns.

itinerary.title: Saturday Mountain Exploration
itinerary.desc: Delicious breakfast, explore Lansdowne pine trails, and enjoy multi-cuisine dinner.

faqs.q: Is parking available for private cars?
faqs.a: Yes, we have free secure parking inside the resort premises.

faqs.q: Can extra bed be added for children?
faqs.a: Yes, extra bed is available at ₹800/night.

inclusions: Exclusive access to 200-guest Banquet Hall & Fairy-lit Outdoor Lawns

itinerary.title: Guest Arrival & Mehendi/Sangeet
itinerary.desc: Welcome drinks, check-in, afternoon Mehendi on lawns, and evening Sangeet with DJ & bonfire.

itinerary.title: Haldi & Wedding Ceremony

faqs.q: What is the guest capacity for weddings?

faqs.q: Do you provide decor and catering?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide complete in-house catering and decor packages.
